about: What the public Mac release bundles from models/manifest.json (scripts/fetch_models.py bundle). A model not named here is bundled whole when required and left out when optional. Every rule says why.

arc-v1.note: Whissle's own model (CC BY-NC 4.0); Moonshine tiny inside is MIT. Licence + NOTICE ship in Resources/Licenses. decoder_v1e (138 MB) is left out: the server uses the tagged decoder, and arc_audio only loads v1e when the file exists (else the built-in decoder).

arctag.note: Whissle's own model (CC BY-NC 4.0 + Whissle terms).

answer-lm.note: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (Alibaba Cloud / Qwen team), Apache 2.0: LICENSE ships in the model folder and Resources/Licenses. Writes the on-device answer; no key needed.

index-data.note: Only the Wikipedia leads (knowledge/: 11,085 lead paragraphs, every row's url is en.wikipedia.org; CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution). The local-moments index (arc/, audio/, docs.jsonl, vectors.npz, retrieval_eval.json) is built from broadcast clips and private recordings (incl. a parent-teacher meeting) and must never ship; local-moments search is simply absent in the release.

demo-audio.note: Only Replay questions synthesised with Kokoro-82M (Apache 2.0; eval/make_audio.py, eval/multipart/make_audio.py, eval/showcase/make_audio.py voice them through eval/tts_kokoro.py). Clips voiced with macOS system voices, recorded voices and the local-moments questions are left out.
